### containers ###
qonnectra_backend_dev Up 32 minutes
qonnectra_backend_wms_dev Up 30 minutes
qonnectra_caddy_dev Up 32 minutes
qonnectra_db_dev Up 32 minutes (healthy)
qonnectra_frontend_dev Up 27 minutes
qonnectra_nginx_dev Up 30 minutes
qonnectra_pg_error_parser_dev Up 32 minutes
qonnectra_qgis_server_dev Up 32 minutes (healthy)
qonnectra_tileserver_dev Up 4 minutes (healthy)
### migrations ###
108
### endpoints ###
api.localhost/api/v1/ -> 200
app.localhost/ -> 303
admin.localhost/admin/login/ -> 200
tiles.localhost/health -> 200
### qgis direct health ###
  HTTP/1.1 500
  Server: QGIS FCGI server - QGIS version 3.44.7-Solothurn

observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "### containers ###"; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps --format '{{.Name}} {{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "### migrations ###"; docker exec qonnectra_backend_dev python manage.py showmigrations --plan 2>/dev/null | grep -c "\[X\]"
echo "### endpoints ###"
for h in "api.localhost /api/v1/" "app.localhost /" "admin.localhost /admin/login/" "tiles.localhost /health"; do set -- $h; echo -n "$1$2 -> "; curl -sk --resolve $1:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://$1$2; done
echo "### qgis direct health ###"; docker exec qonnectra_qgis_server_dev wget -qO- "http://localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" -S 2>&1 | grep -i "QGIS FCGI\|HTTP/1.1"
